name: Chick Clicker
detailed_description:
Welcome to Chick Clicker

Start with a single chicken and a pocket full of feed. In this 3D style chicken idle game, you hatch, harvest, and hustle your way from humble henhouse to unstoppable chicken empire. Your feathery workforce lays the groundwork—literally—for your rise to farming fame.

Upgrade coops, automate feeding, and discover rare breeds with ridiculous productivity. Whether you’re a hands-on farmer or a laid-back egg tycoon, there’s always a bigger barn on the horizon.

Can you turn a sleepy little farm into the clucking capital of the world?

KEY FEATURES

  • Build a Chicken Army
    Tap, hatch, and collect coins as you grow your farm. The more eggs you gather, the bigger your flock becomes!

  • Smarter Chickens, Bigger Profits
    Level up your chickens and improve key skills like movement speed, hatch rate, and farm production. Every egg counts toward your feathered fortune.

  • Unlock Automation
    Buy upgrades to automate your farm and hatch eggs automatically. Chickens can be upgraded to deal with farm production.

Dev in the Coop
Expect regular updates, new features, and fresh content every 1–2 months. I'm always cluckin' up something new!

Build your farm, grow your flock, and let the chickens do the rest!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10, 11, 12
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
